admission.justification: All start routes exclude caller permission authority; the catalog validates ordinary least-mode or explicitly selected cross-scope host-default mode before launch.

applicability: Every role start route that resolves a working mode.
conditions: Only an omitted cross-scope step-up mode takes the offered host default; ordinary fallback remains least working.
Unknown catalogs and unoffered named modes refuse before creation.
exclusions: Caller-supplied mode arguments or permission-bearing feature arguments, which no start route accepts.
statement: No start route accepts a caller mode or permission-bearing feature argument. Ordinary starts without an applicable authored mode use the least offered working mode; an explicitly selected cross-provider/model step-up with omitted mode uses the offered host default. Unknown or unoffered modes refuse by name.
